senses.gloss: f. (tabula, tabella, τάβλα) plank, board, tablet for writing; book of accounts, list; will.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 4:8">Erub. IV, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Eruvin 49b:8">49ᵇ</cite>) <he>כטבלה מרובעת</he> (Talm. ed. <he>כטבלא</he>) like a square tablet.

<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 2:8">R. Hash. II, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 24a">24ᵃ</cite>) <he>על הט׳ בכותל</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בט׳ ובכותל</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) (drawings of the phases of the moon) on a tablet on the wall.

Gitt. 20ᵃ כתב שע״ג ט׳ ופינקס writing (of manumission) on a tablet or on a board (account book or will, v. Treat. ‘Ăbadim, ed. Kirchh. ch. III, Rev. des Etudes Juives 1883, p. 150). Y. Snh. I, 18ᵈ bot. ט׳ של רפואות list of (superstitious) remedies (Pes. 56ᵃ ספר וכ׳); a. fr.—[Y. Bets. I, 60ᶜ bot. טבלה ברייתא וכ׳ (read טַבְלָתָה pl.) the outside stone plates of the colonnade of Asi.]—Pl. טַבְלָאוֹת, טַבְלָיוֹת. Y. B. Bath. VI, 14ᶜ bot. ט׳ של שיש וכ׳ polished marble plates for walls.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 426:1">Yalk. Ex. 426</cite> <he>ונראין ט׳ ט׳ וכ׳</he> and they appeared like marked off squares surrounding &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 57a:6">Pes. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>ט׳ של זהב</he> gold plates.—Chald. pl. <he>טַבְלָתָה</he>, v. supra.
